user.title: Choose whole-home meter
user.description: Select the HA power sensor that represents total whole-home consumption. We will then build a filtered electrical-load list.

commission.title: Electrical-load commissioning
commission.description: {count} electrical-load candidates passed the filter. All are adopted into the Energy Attribution environment and selected by default. Uncheck anything you do not want monitored, then submit. This is a bulk selection step — there is no one-device-at-a-time commissioning.

init.title: Electrical-load commissioning
init.description: {count} current electrical-load candidates are shown. Check the devices you want monitored. Changes here only affect Energy Attribution; Home Assistant devices are not modified.

abort.no_candidates: No direct power or energy load measurements were found after filtering.
